_note: First teaser for RoboRacer going 3D (route /3d, branch revamp/going-3d). Unlisted: nothing links here yet. This file is served publicly, so keep internal notes out of it. Copy is not in the roboracer-content skill yet: Cedric confirms it before merge. hero.banners is a temporary set of candidates for review (?banner=<id> switches them); trim to the chosen one before merge.

hero.tagline: Autonomous racing, off the flat track.

banner.alt: The RoboRacer off-road car head-on atop a red hump, campus buildings blurred behind

portrait.alt: The RoboRacer off-road car on top of a red hump, front 3/4, campus buildings behind

terrain.title: Off the flat track
terrain.lead: Since 2016, RoboRacer has raced on flat floors. The next tracks rise and fall.

car.title: A first look
car.lead: The same 1/10-scale chassis. Swap the 2D LiDAR for a 3D depth camera: a small change to the hardware, but a big transition to end-to-end perception, planning and control algorithms.
car.alt: The RoboRacer off-road car turning on a dark stage, from one front quarter past its face to the other: a stereo camera and two antennas on top, knobby tires, red shocks

callouts.title: Vision-based
callouts.body: A stereo depth camera sees the track in 3D.

callouts.title: 3D positioning
callouts.body: Visual-inertial: the camera plus an IMU.

callouts.title: 3D planning
callouts.body: It plans its path over the terrain.

items.title: The simulator
items.body: Test your code on hilly terrain.

image.alt: A simulated RoboRacer car on a wavy asphalt track over grassy hills, trees behind
The car's live map of an indoor track, turned to fill the frame: the planned route, its position and the point cloud it builds

items.title: The car
items.body: The full specs of the retrofit.

image.alt: The RoboRacer off-road car from the front 3/4 on a red hump, its stereo camera and antennas on top, campus buildings behind

race.title: See you in Seoul
race.lead: Dates, rules and registration to be announced. Until then, the RoboRacer community talks on Slack.
